description: Source code for the CostOptimizationHubClient class, which provides an SDK client to interact with AWS Cost Optimization Hub service. The class defines methods for retrieving preferences, recommendations, enrollment statuses, and updating preferences and enrollment statuses, along with their async counterparts.

classes.name: CostOptimizationHubClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Cost Optimization Hub service, extending the core AwsClient class.

methods.description: Retrieves user preferences related to cost optimization.
